name: IoT Zero-Day LOAO
description: Code and results for "Fine-Tuned Language Encoders for Zero-Day IoT Intrusion Detection: A Cross-Network Leave-One-Attack-Out Benchmark With Label-Free Calibration" (IEEE Access, submitted). LOAO protocols on NF-ToN-IoT-v3 / NF-BoT-IoT-v3, warm-up threshold calibration, RF/MLP/BERT detectors.
